{{Top|leg}}
The '''Karthakk resistance''' was an anti-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] resistance movement active in the [[Karthakk sector/Legends|Karthakk sector]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. It was known for its ability to raise respectable fleets and armies from its own resources. The Karthakk resistance later joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and was reorganized as the [[Karthakk Sector Force]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
